map.倒计时天数 =（婚礼日期 − 当前日期）÷ 86400000 向上取整；筹备节点: Days remaining = ceil((wedding date − today) ÷ 86,400,000); preparation milestones are counted backward from the wedding day: 12 months to book the venue and fix the date, 6 months for photography and the officiant, 3 months to send invitations and settle the menu, 1 month to confirm guests and rehearse the schedule, 1 week to prepare the item checklist. Once fewer than 30 days remain you enter the confirm-and-rehearse stage; milestone completion = completed items ÷ due items × 100%.

The tool divides preparation into stages by days remaining — over 90 days to "set the direction", 30–90 days to "work out the details", 7–30 days to "sprint" and under 7 days to "wrap up" — and lists what each stage needs. With 11 days left, the focus should be confirming headcount, the seating plan and the day-of schedule rather than revisiting the overall plan.
